The '''Mauler Apprentice Camp''' was a small camp located near the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was inhabited by the apprentices of the [[Maulers]], a criminal group.<ref name="SWG:TMPW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Typho - More Police Work|Naboo}}</ref> The camp was targeted during a first [[Royal Security Police Force]] [[Royal Security Forces police raid on Mauler base|operation]],<ref name="SWG:TPW" /> and later during the [[Capture of Doogal Belstar|hunt]] for [[Doogal Belstar]].<ref name="SWG:TMPW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mauler Apprentice Camp was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TPW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mauler Apprentice Camp was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
